name: io.github.livevariant/livevariant
title: LiveVariant
description: Build, inspect and read adaptive A/B tests. Config travels in the URL; no account or API key needed.

environmentVariables.name: LIVEVARIANT_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted LiveVariant deployment. Omit to use the hosted service at https://livevariant.com.

environmentVariables.name: LIVEVARIANT_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token for a self-hosted deployment that sets LV_API_TOKEN. Not needed for the hosted service.

environmentVariables.name: LIVEVARIANT_ASSET_UPLOAD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Asset upload token for a deployment with hosted images enabled. Optional.
